h3.reader_explanation: The full table preserves every requested cell, so the main figures cannot hide unavailable or inconvenient variables.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For ln(x) for every eligible continuous variable with x>0: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: The log compresses large values and describes proportional differences; it has a different sample when zeros or negative values are present.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: N_level=N_log_positive+N_zero+N_negative among valid level records; missing/invalid states are outside that identity and separately counted.
h3.reader_explanation: Changing to logs can change which factories are represented, so the removed zeros and negative values stay visible.

h2.title: Mean versus median across continuous variables

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: Mean versus median across continuous variables?
h3.formula: Plot mean and P50 with P25–P75 interval for each continuous variable; separate unit scales; retain P95/P99 in appendix.
h3.reader_explanation: The gap between mean and median shows how strongly large observations affect the average; the interval is distribution spread.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For workers: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: The median locates a typical observed factory; the interquartile range contains the middle half and the upper quantiles expose the long tail.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For nominal output: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: Large amounts can pull the mean far above the median. Across years these nominal amounts also reflect price differences.

latex_outline.lead_question: Separate legitimate sensitivity from primary definition.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For nominal value added: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: Value added is what remains after intermediate inputs; admissible negative values stay in levels and cannot enter the positive-log summary.

h2.title: Separate capital stock and addition distributions

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: Separate capital stock and addition distributions?
h3.formula: For capital stock and capital additions, in separate panels: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: The stock is what the factory owns; additions describe a flow during the year. They are never merged into one variable.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For output/workers, value_added/workers and capital_stock/workers, separately: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: A per-worker amount divides by measured workers; it does not account for hours, worker skills or causal labor productivity.

h2.title: Energy costs versus physical quantity units

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: Energy costs versus physical quantity units?
h3.formula: List native unit, canonical unit, price basis, conversion evidence and source-status rule for each variable-year.
h3.reader_explanation: Physical quantity, spending and a logarithm have different units and must not share an unexplained scale.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For every binary concept report yes, no, unknown, yes/(yes+no); for categorical concepts count every valid code and unknown category.
h3.reader_explanation: A frequency table describes the meaning of a response; the mean of arbitrary category numbers would not.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Count working, verified, provisional and missing states; compute working and verified-only distributions from their own records.
h3.reader_explanation: A difference between working and verified-only summaries combines changes in which values are accepted and which observations remain.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Mark every documented change in question, universe, unit, classification and verification status at its actual calendar year.
h3.reader_explanation: A break in a graph is not automatically an economic change; the definition may have changed.

h3.purpose: Each year’s contribution to the pooled sample?
h3.formula: year_weight=N_eligible_year/sum_years(N_eligible_year)*100
h3.reader_explanation: A pooled summary gives more weight to years with more usable records unless an equal-year rule is explicitly used.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For each supported year assign record weight w_i=1/N_y; compute weighted mean=sum(w_i*x_i)/sum(w_i), and weighted CDF quantiles using the same frozen weighted definition.
h3.reader_explanation: This sensitivity gives each year equal influence. It is not the average of annual medians.

h2.title: Raw/status/identifier fields not described as amounts

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: Raw/status/identifier fields not described as amounts?
h3.formula: Enumerate every code with its source vintage, label, validity and documented comparison universe.
h3.reader_explanation: A code is a label for an activity or place; arithmetic on the label does not describe economic magnitude.

h2.title: All structurally absent or unsupported cells

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning

h3.formula: Count and retain every expected variable × transform × period × group × branch cell; label absent source, no eligible record, low N or unsupported definition.
h3.reader_explanation: An empty cell remains part of the report, with a reason that distinguishes no observations from no source information.

summary_protocol.quantiles: Stata default percentile definition recorded with command/version, applied identically in all cells; do not mix percentile algorithms across display/validation
summary_protocol.dispersion: Sample SD with n-1 denominator when n>=2, missing when n<2; IQR=P75-P25
summary_protocol.zero_and_negative: Include only where valid for the named level concept; positive-only log sample is separately counted; never add1 silently
summary_protocol.pooled_primary: Each eligible observed record receives weight1; keep year composition visible. Pool only compatible definitions and price basis, with nominal pooled amounts explicitly labelled mixed-current-price distributions.
summary_protocol.pooled_equal_year_sensitivity: Each observation in year y gets weight1/n_y so each supported year contributes equal total weight; weighted statistic definition/quantile implementation is explicit, not arithmetic averaging of annual medians
summary_protocol.categorical: Frequency and known-response share tables, not means of arbitrary code labels; metadata/IDs receive source-role inventory rather than economic statistics
summary_protocol.sparse_cells: Retain every tuple in CSV; n<2 gives unavailable SD; chart unavailable/low-N labels are separate from complete numeric registry. No hidden top-ten substitution.

dataflow_protocol.input_integrity: Physical source data and source-definition evidence are separate declared inputs. Pin both before transforming a value.
dataflow_protocol.join_keys: Never merge by row order. Use declared keys and assert intended 1:1, m:1 or explicitly weighted 1:m cardinality; record unmatched and duplicate rows.
dataflow_protocol.source_rows: source_year/source_row identifies a row within the frozen canonical source family, not a longitudinal plant. If another source family is added, source_file_hash is part of the raw key until the canonical manifest proves uniqueness.
dataflow_protocol.branch_status: Each branch produces either a validated state or a typed unsupported receipt with the missing prerequisite. Unsupported receipts are not numeric datasets and cannot satisfy a required input gate.
dataflow_protocol.missing_states: Source absence, inapplicable questionnaire universe, parse failure, unknown unit, masked identifier, observed zero and valid positive/negative values remain distinguishable.
dataflow_protocol.downstream_gate: Only a passed input contract may unlock its dependent statistical branch. Publishing a diagnostic about a blocked branch does not complete the Word row.
